source_row.extraction_instructions: Preside/Eventfolio site; the calendar lists every upcoming event as article.eventfolio-calendar-event (date range, title link, type badge, city, CPD, Free/External badges); filters and result counter are JS-only and there is no pagination. Detail pages have an event-header block (date, venue lines), a ticket-price widget and a Book Now link to the organiser. Flagship meeting fees are in a PDF on a sub-page.

registry_comment: SBNS (neurosurgery) event calendar: Eventfolio cards -> event pages; society meetings plus external courses; fee widget + organiser Book Now link

concerns: Flagship fees: detail_from_html follows event page -> '<folder>/registration-and-accommodation.html' (folder must match the page slug, as the nav lists other years' meetings) -> the '/asset/<id>/' PDF (no .pdf suffix, fetched with httpx, text via abstract_classifier.pdf_bytes_to_text) -> fee_tiers_from_pdf_text. Verified live on SBNS 100: 54 tiers, GBP, e.g. 'Full Meeting Attendance (4 days) · SBNS Full Members & International HIC Consultants · Early until 1 August' 650.0 (early bird, deadline 2026-08-01) and '... · Standard until 14 September' 760.0. SBNS 100 itself ended 2026-10-16 so it is not among the 11 shells; the path is unit-tested on it, and is exercised for Glasgow 2027 only once that meeting publishes a Registration sub-page with a PDF. Image-only or table-less PDFs yield tiers [].
Listing filters/result counter are JS-only but all upcoming cards are in the server HTML (11 after dropping SBNS 100); no pagination.
A second venue span on some pages is an unrelated address (De Vere Beaumont Estate on the Edinburgh workshop); only the first line of the last venue span is used.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges (end_date) checked against the page on every source; no fee-table images were seen on the tested pages; SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT warnings from the harness --coverage run were false positives (related-event lists / unrelated '4 days' wording on the same page). The two SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT hits are other events' date ranges in the page's Related events block.
remediator.audit not run (needs the database); harness --coverage was run instead.

Review fixes: (a) the Neuroradiology Workshop's SBNS widget says Free but its external Book Now page (RCSEd) charges, so a Free-only widget is no longer stored when the booking link is external: tiers [] and organiser_url set for the explorer. (b) The fee-PDF fetch streams and caps at 5 MB. (c) Promoter gate: titles like '<ordinal> International/World/Global ... Conference/Congress/Summit' are dropped and logged at INFO; this removed the '6th International Neurosurgery and Neurological Surgeons Conference' (Kuala Lumpur), leaving 10 shells. The gate is title-only and could in principle drop a genuine numbered international congress; none is listed today.
